title: Kirstan Brodie
text:
I am a Postdoctoral Associate in the Department of Psychology and Neuroscience at the University of Colorado Boulder working with Dr. Youngki Hong. I completed my PhD in Psychology at Cornell University.
I study the cognitive and neural mechanisms underlying biases in social learning and perception. My research focuses on how stereotypes are formed and maintained, and how person perception shifts across group boundaries and social contexts. I use a multi-method approach to explore these questions, including behavioral experiments, computational modeling, and fMRI.
